description: This file defines the Ext.ux.ToolbarDroppable plugin class for Ext JS library version 3.2.1. The class enables drag-and-drop functionality onto toolbars, allowing items to be dropped and dynamically added as toolbar items. It includes methods for initializing drop targets, calculating insertion points, handling drops, and creating new toolbar items based on drop data.

classes.name: Ext.ux.ToolbarDroppable
classes.description: A plugin class that adds drag-and-drop capabilities to an Ext.Toolbar, allowing items to be dropped onto the toolbar and be converted into toolbar items using a customizable createItem function.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with a configuration object.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the plugin by attaching to a toolbar instance and creating the drop target when the toolbar is rendered.

methods.name: createDropTarget
methods.description: Creates the Ext.dd.DropTarget on the toolbar element to handle drag-and-drop events.

methods.name: addDDGroup
methods.description: Adds a drag-and-drop group name to the drop target.

methods.name: calculateEntryIndex
methods.description: Calculates the insertion index for a new item based on the drop event's XY position.

methods.name: canDrop
methods.description: Determines whether a drag source is allowed to drop on the toolbar. Defaults to always true.

methods.name: notifyOver
methods.description: Provides visual feedback during drag-over to indicate whether dropping is allowed.

methods.name: notifyDrop
methods.description: Handles the drop event, creates and inserts a new toolbar item, and calls the afterLayout callback.

methods.name: createItem
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented to create a toolbar item given the drop data.

methods.name: afterLayout
methods.description: Hook for additional processing after a new item has been added to the toolbar.
